working-directory.description: Directory containing the Cargo workspace root and rust-toolchain.toml.

nextest-profile.description: cargo-nextest profile passed to --profile. The profile must exist in .config/nextest.toml unless it is default.

nextest-arguments.description: Whitespace-separated cargo nextest run arguments added after --profile.

nextest-version.description: cargo-nextest version installed from a prebuilt binary.

sqlx-offline.description: Exports SQLX_OFFLINE=true so sqlx query macros compile against committed .sqlx metadata.

require-docker.description: Fails before compiling when no Docker daemon is reachable. Set true for testcontainers integration tests.

enable-cache.description: Restores and saves the Cargo registry and target cache with Swatinem/rust-cache when true. Set false for cold-build validation or runners without cache service access.

upload-diagnostics.description: Uploads diagnostics artifact when true. Set false for local act smoke tests that cannot emulate upload-artifact.
